notes.title: Update 1.2.3 - Item Inspecting and Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42284117/6a1f4d3a4d705c362c92c370038a27aab7e0e5ae.png[/img]


[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Inspect items in scene by holding [Alt] to display the set it belongs to.
[*] VSync and Frame Rate Cap options are available in the Settings.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rainbow coins contribute more to Banks and Vending Machines.
[*] Added more symbols to the customisable Sign: droplet and apple.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where items were not updating their position after being moved.
(this should solve the area selection bugs that were causing items to teleport away)
[*] Fixed dragged items being shrunk after hovering over the Duplication Bag.
[*] Fixed missing highlight outlines on Swamp Water tiles.
[*] Fixed Secret item hints not displaying in the Collection screen after being discovered.
[*] Fixed an issue where game settings would not visually change when clicked on.
[*] Edited descriptions for the Falling Leaf items, to be consistent with other effect items.
[/list]

notes.title: Garden Galaxy Frost Update
notes.content:
[h2]Update 1.2.2[/h2]

[h3]Frost Set[/h3]
Snow has arrived in a seasonal themed set with 14 unique items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42284117/46655000e592424cf51106d6e8fa85c187760ac4.png[/img]

[h3]Gifts[/h3]
Over time, the Pot will gift you free items as a thank you for spending coins! These gifts contain items that can be especially useful when starting out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42284117/43675a95c42af824f971ab4c7fd244fa6e48c61b.png[/img]

[h3]More![/h3]
[list]
[*] Waterfall tiles to match the Beach and Swamp water tiles.
[*] [Rainbow] Organise or decorate with a customisable sign.
[*] [Forest] Fir trees can now stack to be taller.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42284117/cb4342a64e797521019d710e1dd53863342af16a.png[/img]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Collection Screen: added the ability to reset/remove an item's customisation effect.
[*] Added visual feedback on the HUD when trying to move locked ground.
[*] Reduced the frequency of receiving the slope or stair tile variants.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the appearance-changing Cauldron not accepting ground tiles.
[*] Fixed the 'coins spent' counter incorrectly increasing when a Rainbow coin is spent or a statue is sold.
[/list]

notes.title: Anniversary + Update News
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Today marks one year since the release of Garden Galaxy!

It's been fun to see your gardens come to life on streams and in the community!
We appreciate every player and anybody who has supported the game <3

[h3]Next Update[/h3]

We're happy to announce that there'll be another [b]content update on 19th December[/b]!

Take a peek at some of the new items coming soon ❄️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42284117/46655000e592424cf51106d6e8fa85c187760ac4.png[/img]

notes.title: Nominate Garden Galaxy for the Steam Awards 2023!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings[/h3]

The Steam Awards are here and Garden Galaxy is eligible for an award!

If you've enjoyed playing Garden Galaxy and it helped you to unwind, it would mean so much to us if you could nominate Garden Galaxy for the Steam Awards in the category [b]Sit Back and Relax[/b].

We hope you've been enjoying the game as much as we love developing it - we're currently working on the next content update ❄️

Cheers!

notes.title: Garden Galaxy Harvest Update
notes.content:
Bring a bit of Autumn into your gardens with today's update 🍂

To celebrate, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1970460/]Garden Galaxy is 20% off[/url][/b] for one week, from today 16th October 10am PST until 23rd October 10am PST!

[h2]Update 1.2.1[/h2]

[h3]New Harvest Set[/h3]
[list]
[*]Harvest set: a seasonal themed set with 14 unique items.
[*] New orange-ish colour theme added to the existing Paint Roller options.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42284117/d1ced09a5c5f4d90d3f7aee1d1c8fc015174941c.png[/img]

[h3]More New Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] [spoiler][Curio] Cauldron variant: chance to convert an item into another one of its variants.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler][Rainbow] Dark Pot: destroys items, including coins.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gambling Dice: very slightly increased the chance to win and added a bonus chance to also win a Rainbow coin.
[*] Updated the tooltip for the Cauldron, to clarify its function.
[*] Added a new set completion achievement.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Rainbow storage bases not being storable, even if there was space.
[*] Fixed an issue where items were being auto-sold for Rainbow coins instead of their set coins.
[*] Fixed a case where the Duplication Bag would provide more ground tiles than intended.
[*] Fixed items from the Cauldron not stacking properly until the game was reloaded.
[/list]

notes.title: Update coming 16th October
notes.content:
Hello!

Popping in to let you all know that there's a Garden Galaxy update planned for 16th October, which will feature a new set of Autumn themed items 🍂

notes.title: Garden Galaxy Summer Update
notes.content:
Hello!

Garden Galaxy's Summer Update is here 🌞
Discover over 30 new items and get creative with 2 new sets!

[h3]Beach and Swamp sets[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42284117/ae8da9019f361c31031f12dd4e6c6c250cff4d7b.png[/img]
[b]Notable New Items[/b]
Avoid these spoilers if you'd prefer to find everything yourself!
[list]
[*] [spoiler]Glowing Mushroom: adds a glowing spore environment effect.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Message in a bottle: contains messages that display stats of your game.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Net: collects random items over time while placed in water.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Tortoises![/spoiler]
[/list]

[h3]Collection Screen[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now with less scrolling! Quickly jump to a set by clicking on its coin at the top.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42284117/ca02662388c00c079162c6f744b62cf293584b40.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Settings: added an option to change the Anti-Aliasing quality.
[*] Settings: added options to disable Bloom and SSAO.
[*] Added 2 set completion achievements.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare softlock where The Pot could not be moved or used after selling items.
[*] Fixed an issue where larger items would get moved with nearby items.
[*] Fixed smaller items being unselectable after being placed onto certain water tiles.
[*] Fixed an issue where items could not be moved if the camera was moving.
[*] Fixed various items blocking the selection of other items behind.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.0.3 - A Tiny Update
notes.content:
Hello!

Over the past few weeks Garden Galaxy has seen lots of new and returning players enjoying the game and the update - thank you so much <3

This is an update to fix a few things that may have caused some problems. Thank you all for the continued support and bug reports, we really appreciate it!

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Air block tiles can now be placed onto the water and waterfall tiles.
[*] All fruit items can float on water.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed items that couldn't be sold or used because a delivery crate was stuck on them.
[*] Fixed visitors being covered up by delivery crates on stations.
[*] Fixed air block tiles sometimes not aligning vertically when placed onto raised pond or soil bed tiles.
[*] Fixed the red invalid placement effect not appearing when moving items for the first time.
[*] Fixed food orders being displayed twice.
[/list]

notes.title: Garden Galaxy is a relaxing idle sandbox filled with pots and plants
notes.content:
In Garden Galaxy, you arrange randomly delivered pots, plants, furniture and ornaments into your own happy little scene. I spent a contented evening with it a few weeks ago, fussing over the shape of my water feature and the angle of my gnome.

If you like tinkering and tidying, I think you'd like it too, and this week it has received a major new update with lots more items to play with.

Read more

notes.title: Garden Galaxy Bounty Update
notes.content:
Hello!

Today, we're super excited to release Garden Galaxy's first major update: [b]Bounty[/b] 🌈

This update is about giving you lots more items, designed to help you complete your Collection and manage your garden. It features [b]2 new sets, over 50 new items in total, and area selection[/b]!

[h2]Rainbow Coin[/h2]
Introducing a special new coin: the Rainbow coin. These are gifted from Rainbow visitors and can be spent to gain multiple items at once, picked from all sets. Keep an eye out for these elusive Rainbow visitors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42284117/2da0db03ce0105bf2682635dbeb9af6432b6ba1b.png[/img]

[h2]Area Selection[/h2]
It's here! Organise and build more efficiently by moving multiple stacks. The selection also works with the ground lock option to make it easier to move your decorations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42284117/0d03933a354373bd2ab59b0d67669108a78ec9bb.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes 1.1.0[/h2]

[h3]NEW[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rainbow visitors that arrive to gift you Rainbow coins.
[*] Rainbow set: a variety of special items.
[*] Market set: outdoor market and food items.
[*] 50+ items to be found across all sets, featuring new mechanics (spoilers below for details).
[*] Area selection: use Ctrl + LMB drag to make a selection, then LMB drag to move it.
[/list]

[h3]Notable new items and features[/h3]
Avoid these spoilers if you'd prefer to find everything yourself!
[list]
[*] [spoiler]Visitor 'stations' where visitors will prioritise stopping at.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Coin-only storage with enough space for a stack of each coin in the game, up to 999.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Vending Machine to buy items - available item cycles after time or once bought out.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Vanishing items that can be used to float terrain and decorations.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Waypoint signs to quickly move to other areas of your garden.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Special type of storage that moves itself to delivery stations.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Vendor Cart where food orders can be fulfilled to earn coins.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Camera items that can apply lens and colour filter effects.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]2 new insect critter types.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Coins can now be placed on shrines to boost their drop rate.
[*] Increased the maximum coin stack queue of The Pot from 40 to 99.
[*] All item storage slots have been increased from 6 to 8.
[*] Added holes to the Firefly's jar lid (sorry, firefly).
[*] Tealights can now be placed on water.
[*] Bunting has been moved from the Lawn set to the Market set.
[*] Watering Can has been moved from the Water set to the Gold set.
[*] Inserted a new step in the tutorial to explain area selection.
[*] Collection icons for critter items now actually feature the critters.
[*] Reduced the hold input delay when taking a stack of items out of storage.
[*] Increased the maximum stack of coins when being taken out of storage, from 10 to 30.
[*] Increased the drop chance for rarer items.
[*] Added 2 set completion achievements.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed visitors sometimes spawning in empty space while items are being moved.
[*] Fixed The Pot giving coins out of order after stacks of items have been sold.
[*] Fixed background stars rendering in front of items when the view is zoomed out.
[/list]

notes.title: Garden Galaxy update 1.0.10
notes.content:
[h3]Update[/h3]
This update includes some improvements, fixes and most importantly... corner tiles!
Expand your garden's terrain using new corner shapes for all existing slopes and stairs.
See the patch notes below for more changes.

[h3]Future Development[/h3]
We're also very busy working on a major feature & content update. We're excited to show you more soon!

Thank you to the community for being so positive and creative!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42284117/e2d0f9298acf098d85c40aa682af0b7637f49cff.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes 1.0.10[/h2]

[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Corner tiles have been added for all existing slopes and stairs.
Click on a slope or stairs to switch between the different shapes.
[*] 7 new item variations. Find them in the Farm, Urban and Lawn set.
[*] Plants can now be planted into the Ball Tree, Round Bush and Hedge.
[*] Items that can now be stacked upon: Ball Tree, Round Bush, Star Light.
[*] The barbecue can be turned on!
[/list]
[h3]Collection Screen[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added small icons to represent the function of an item.
[*] Hovering over the coin of a set's header will display that set's name.
[*] Added a category for secret items (appears if at least one secret item has been discovered**).
[/list]
[h3]System[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed how save files are written to disk, to help protect existing saves if there is any corruption while writing new ones.
[*] Added an in-game notification if saving fails.
[*] Auto saves are now made every 5 minutes (previously every minute).
[*] Extended the range of the camera zoom.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes / Optimisations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the dry grass slope being stackable. Existing stacks will persist until the tiles are moved.
[*] Fixed grass sometimes disappearing after dragging a ground tile above.
[*] Fixed some plants that weren't animating when watered or moved.
[*] Fixed fish not moving after being placed directly from storage.
[*] Fixed the hosepipe facing the wrong direction.
[*] Fixed certain situations where items weren't being recorded in the Collection if they were put straight into storage.
[*] Reduced the number of draw calls for all soil tiles and planter soil, improving rendering performance in large gardens.
[/list]
** [i]For existing saves: secret items that aren't in storage or placed in the scene will need to be found again to be revealed in the Collection.[/i]

notes.title: 1.0.4 - Fix
notes.content: - Fixed a particle effect that was causing a visual glitch whenever an item landed.

notes.title: 1.0.3 - Small Patch
notes.content:
[b]Settings[/b]
- Fullscreen can now be used with lower resolutions.
- Added an option to keep the audio playing while the game is in the background.

[b]Other[/b]
- Slightly increased the drop rate for all set coins.
- Improved rendering performance when there are many particle effects.

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixed visitor coins landing inside each other when a coin stack is almost full.
- Fixed the invalid placement indicator being hidden in some cases.
- Fixed items that weren’t scaling correctly when used with [spoiler]the cauldron[/spoiler].
